scheme: 47-tile blob, same rule as water_shore. Mask = neighbours that are FOGGED (off-map counts as fogged): NE=1 (r-1,c), E=2 (r-1,c+1), SE=4 (r,c+1), S=8 (r+1,c+1), SW=16 (r+1,c), W=32 (r+1,c-1), NW=64 (r,c-1), N=128 (r-1,c-1). Clear a corner bit unless both its edge bits are set. Column = index of reduced mask in "masks". 255 = full fog (same as fog.png). Drawn on the fogged tile only; visible tiles need nothing.
note: 32x24, diamond rows 8-23, puffs up to 8px above. Draw back-to-front with terrain. Replaces fog_edge_se.
